title: What ...! How ...!
text: Su Hai and Su Yang are tidying their room. Rewrite the underlined sentences with "what" or "how".
Look at these books. They're very old.
And the plastic bags. They're very dirty. We need to throw them away too.
That's a great idea. We can recycle these old books. They should go in the blue bin.
What about the dirty plastic bags? Can they go in the blue bin too?
No. We can't recycle plastic bags. They should go in the grey bin.
sentences: Su Hai and Su Yang are tidying their room.
We can recycle these old books.
They should go in the blue bin.
